title: Turkey Burgers
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the turkey mince, egg, breadcrumbs, and spices.
Mix by hand until just combined (do not overwork the meat or it will become tough).
Divide the mixture into 4 equal portions and shape into tight patties about 1-inch thick.
Heat a non-stick pan or grill over medium-high heat with a light spray of oil.
Cook the patties for 5-6 minutes per side until the internal temperature reaches 75°C.
Let the burgers rest for 2 minutes before serving in buns with your favorite toppings.

title: Mediterranean Chicken Bake
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Place the sliced peppers, courgette, and cherry tomatoes in a large baking dish.
Nestle the chicken breasts among the vegetables.
Drizzle everything with olive oil and lemon juice, then sprinkle generously with oregano, salt, and pepper.
Place lemon slices on top of the chicken for extra flavor.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until the chicken is golden and the vegetables are tender.

title: Veggie Burger
instructions: Place the chickpeas in a bowl and mash with a fork or potato masher until mostly smooth but with some texture remaining.
Stir in the onion, spices, parsley, and flour until a thick dough forms.
If the mixture is too wet, add another tablespoon of flour.
Shape into 4 patties and chill in the fridge for 15 minutes to firm up.
Heat a splash of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Fry the patties for 4-5 minutes on each side until a brown crust forms.

title: Turkey Burger Wrap
ingredients: 1 tbsp Light mayonnaise or Greek yogurt
instructions: Warm the tortilla wrap in a dry pan for 30 seconds to make it pliable.
Spread the mayonnaise or yogurt across the center of the wrap.
Slice the cooked turkey patty into strips and place them on the wrap.
Top with lettuce and tomato.
Fold in the sides of the wrap, then roll tightly from the bottom up.
Optional: Toast the closed wrap in a pan for 1 minute to seal the edge.

title: Creamy Mushroom & Spinach Pasta
ingredients: 100ml Light cooking cream or Elmlea Single
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add mushrooms and cook for 5-7 minutes until they have released their moisture and turned golden.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another 60 seconds.
Lower the heat and stir in the light cream and fresh spinach. Let the spinach wilt into the sauce.
Drain the pasta (reserve a splash of pasta water) and toss into the sauce.
Add a little pasta water if the sauce is too thick, and season with plenty of black pepper.

title: Fillet Steak with Potatoes
ingredients: Sea salt and cracked black pepper
instructions: Take the steak out of the fridge 20 minutes before cooking to reach room temperature.
Halve the baby potatoes and boil in salted water for 12-15 minutes until tender. Drain and set aside.
Season the steak generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a heavy-based pan with oil until smoking hot. Sear the steak for 3 minutes per side (for medium-rare).
Remove the steak and let it rest on a warm plate for 5 minutes.
While the steak rests, toss the asparagus and cooked potatoes into the steak pan for 3-4 minutes to pick up the flavors.

title: Fluffy Keto Buns
instructions: Preheat oven to 175°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, psyllium husk, baking powder, and salt.
Add the egg whites and stir until a thick paste forms.
Carefully pour in the boiling water. Use a hand mixer or whisk to blend for about 30 seconds until the dough thickens and becomes rubbery.
Wet your hands and divide the dough into 6 equal balls. Place them on the baking sheet.
Bake for 50-60 minutes. The buns are done when they sound hollow when tapped on the bottom.
Crucial: Let them cool completely before slicing, or they will be moist inside.

title: Banana Chocolate Oat Cake
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a standard loaf tin or 8-inch square pan.
In a high-speed blender, blitz the oats until they reach a flour-like consistency.
In a large bowl, mash the 4 bananas until they are a smooth liquid.
Stir the oat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and vanilla into the mashed bananas.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Pour the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top.
Bake for 30-35 minutes. A toothpick inserted into the center should come out mostly clean.
Allow to cool in the tin for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

title: High-Protein Yogurt Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°C. Line the bottom of a 6-inch springform pan with parchment paper.
In a bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt until smooth.
Add the eggs one at a time, whisking gently so you don't incorporate too much air.
Sift in the cornstarch and add the vanilla and sweetener. Whisk until perfectly smooth.
Pour the mixture into the pan.
Bake for 45-50 minutes. The edges should be set but the center should still have a slight jiggle.
Turn off the oven and leave the door slightly ajar for 30 minutes to let it cool slowly (this prevents cracking).
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours (ideally overnight) before removing from the pan.
